newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.2 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.2 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.2 percent in the week ended November 30 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 2.1 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was off 0.2 percent from the prior month.

"Post-Thanksgiving shopping, as widely reported, was off to a good start according to retailers," a BTM/Schroder report said. "But some of the healthy tone was set from comparisons with last year," it said.
